questions.prompt: Use this information to answer this question. Atomic No. 9F Mass No. 19 From the information box above we can see that one of the following statements is true.  Which one is it?
options: Francium has more electrons than protons.
Iron has more protons than neutrons.
Flourine has more neutrons than protons.
questions.explanation: Fluorine-19 has 9 protons and 19−9=10 neutrons. The source misspells fluorine.

questions.prompt: In the equation below what are the reactants? H2O +  CO2(aq)                                     H2CO3(aq)
options: There are no reactants in this equation.
questions.explanation: The reactants are the substances on the left: water and carbon dioxide.

questions.prompt:
How many valence electrons does the atom below have?
[LV-MEDIA:{"images":[{"pack":"repo-science-batch32","id":"e70-image1"}]}]
questions.explanation: Seven electrons occupy the outer shell in the pictured 2,8,7 arrangement.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is correct?
options: Silver will lose electrons when forming ions.
Oxygen will lose electrons when forming ions.
Silver is a precious metal so it will never lose or gain electrons.
questions.explanation: Silver forms common positive ions by losing electrons.

questions.prompt: Some atoms can lose electrons.  Some atoms can gain electrons.  When atoms lose or gain electrons they form:
questions.explanation: Ions form when atoms gain or lose electrons and acquire net charge.

questions.prompt: Which of the following will turn blue litmus paper red?
questions.explanation: Vinegar is acidic and turns blue litmus red.

questions.prompt: The electrons in an atom are stored:
questions.explanation: Electrons occupy shells/atomic orbitals around the nucleus in the intended atomic model. They are not in the nucleus or a cell membrane.
